edges.label: Loeb directs the Institute for Theory and Computation at the CfA
edges.note: The paper's affiliation block gives Loeb both affiliations at once - 'Abraham Loeb 1,2', where 1 is 'Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, 60 Garden Street, Cambridge, MA 02138' and 2 is the Galileo Project at the same address - and footnotes him 'Head of the Galileo Project'. This is his institutional home stated in a peer-reviewed record, not on a project page.
